shots.text: When the Thunderhead broke, the sky moved again for the first time in a season. The Galeborn wept in the rain.
shots.speaker: narrator
shots.art_note: The black solid cloud shattering, frozen lightning falling like glass. Rain. Riders lifting their faces to it.

shots.text: We are moving. We are moving again. Who held the road? We will remember it.
shots.speaker: aurath
shots.art_note: Aurath, a rider-shape of cloud and lightning, flickering, bowing over the towers.

shots.text: The Galeborn packed the Sky-Moot onto ten thousand horses and rode for Solenne. Kaela rode last. That is how she learned the word.
shots.speaker: narrator
shots.art_note: The great tent-city of Aurvanis being folded onto horses; a sea of riders heading toward the horizon. Kaela at the back, looking over her shoulder at the empty tent poles.
